title: Marriage epilogue: A Future She Chooses

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Moonwater Quay has never looked so dignified. Pearl ribbons hang over the water, and floating lanterns mark a clear channel for the ocean guests.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The land guests line the stone railings, leaning over as far as manners allow.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Someone has made a seating chart for a celebration where half the guests have no use for seats. It is on its ninth revision.

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I think the seating chart has declared war on geometry.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Three times I have told them. Currents are not assigned tables.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Nerelle waits in the water, in the same high-collared, long-sleeved pearl-and-ocean-blue royal garment she always wears.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Her tail keeps time under the surface. Nobody has brought a spell.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Before we begin, an announcement. I have arranged my duties with the council.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I will go on serving the ocean court. I will also go on making journeys, whenever I see fit.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A murmur runs through the sea guests. A stern court official consults a list, hesitates, then adds a new heading.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: *Arrangements Actually Discussed With the Princess.*

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Look at that. Reform is spreading.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Should I give a speech about our unprecedented cross-cultural scheduling achievements?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “You prepared a speech?”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Only twelve pages. I cut the appendix.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “How merciful.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Then come the vows. You both promise to ask, and to listen, and to tell each other the truth.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: And to keep meeting where the land runs into the sea.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “I choose you, {PLAYER}. And my people. And my home. And every question I have not asked yet.”

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “I’m yours, Nerelle. Keep telling me when I’m wrong about a current.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Then it will be a long marriage. You are wrong about currents quite often.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Later, beside the Gardens canal, Nerelle drifts in the water while you sit on the bank with your feet in it beside her.

intro.speaker: PLAYER
intro.text: “Do you think we planned enough?”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Enough to begin.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “Also, your foot is in the wrong current. It is about to visit the sea court without you.”
